Short title and commencement

ACT XXI OF 2016
ACT XXI OF 2016
EQUITY PARTICIPATION
FUND (REPEAL) ACT, 2016
An Act to repeal the
Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 10th May, 2016]
No. F. 9(4)/2016-Legis, dated 9-5-2016.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 4th
May, 2016 and is hereby published for general information:
WHEREAS
it is expedient to repeal the Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970 (I of
1970) for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Equity Participation Fund (Repeal) Act, 2016.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Repeal

ACT XXI OF 2016
ACT XXI OF 2016
EQUITY PARTICIPATION
FUND (REPEAL) ACT, 2016
An Act to repeal the
Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970
[Gazette
of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 10th May, 2016]
No. F. 9(4)/2016-Legis, dated 9-5-2016.---The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 4th
May, 2016 and is hereby published for general information:
WHEREAS
it is expedient to repeal the Equity Participation Fund Ordinance, 1970 (I of
1970) for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
2. Repeal.---(1) The Equity Participation Fund
Ordinance, 1970 (I of 1970) is hereby repealed.
(2) If
any difficulty arises in giving effect to any of the provisions of this Act,
the Federal Government may, within one year of the commencement of this Act, by
notification in the Official Gazette make such order, not in consistent with
the provisions of the Act being repealed under subsection (1), as may appear to
it to be necessary for the purpose of removing the difficulty.
